text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The word "Leckermaul" is playing on Manhattan Cafe's mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her concerns started with T.M Opera O's bizarre assertion that Manhattan Cafe was "the companion of Leckermaul."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Agnes Tachyon informs us that she'll be preoccupied with her own activities while we're at summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We begin the summer camp with a slew of mixed emotions.
